MirrorOS installation plan (format 4)
================================================================================

1. Target
=========
  Architecture      x86_64
  Memory            4294967296 bytes (4.0 GiB)
  Virtualization    kvm
  System vendor     QEMU
  Product name      Standard PC (Q35 + ICH9, 2009)
  Profile           matched reference-vm (recognized profile; not a
                    qualification of this machine)
  Disk path         /dev/vda
  Disk by-id        virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
  Serial            SYNTH-VDA-0001
  Size              34359738368 bytes (32.0 GiB)

  DESTRUCTIVE: every partition and all data on this disk will be erased.

  Current layout (this content will be destroyed):
    Partition table   gpt 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
    /dev/vda1  536870912 bytes (512.0 MiB); vfat; label SYNTH-ESP
    /dev/vda2  32212254720 bytes (30.0 GiB); ext4; label SYNTH-DATA

3. Destructive operations
=========================
  DESTRUCTIVE wipe_disk_signatures
      Remove existing signatures from the target disk.
  DESTRUCTIVE create_partition_table
      Write an empty GPT on the target disk.
  DESTRUCTIVE create_partitions
      Create the ESP and a root partition on the remaining space.
  DESTRUCTIVE format_filesystems
      Format the ESP and the root partition.

4. Operations in order
======================
  01. wipe_disk_signatures DESTRUCTIVE
      Remove existing signatures from the target disk.
      disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
  02. create_partition_table DESTRUCTIVE
      Write an empty GPT on the target disk.
      disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
      table: gpt
  03. create_partitions DESTRUCTIVE
      Create the ESP and a root partition on the remaining space.
      disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
      esp_size_bytes: 2147483648
      esp_mount_point: /boot
      root: remaining_space
  04. format_filesystems DESTRUCTIVE
      Format the ESP and the root partition.
      esp_filesystem: vfat
      root_filesystem: btrfs
      resolved at apply: partition_uuids (blkid)
  05. create_btrfs_subvolumes
      Create the flat Btrfs subvolumes on the new filesystem.
      subvolumes: @, @home, @log, @pkg, @snapshots, @swap
      mount_options: compress=zstd:1,relatime
  06. mount_target
      Mount the root filesystem and the ESP under the target root.
      esp_mount_point: /boot
      subvolumes: @, @home, @log, @pkg, @snapshots, @swap
  07. install_packages
      Install packages.
      packages: base, linux, linux-firmware, zram-generator, sudo, neovim,
        man-db, man-pages, xkeyboard-config, networkmanager, btrfs-progs,
        snapper, snap-pac, compsize, limine, efibootmgr, libnotify, gettext,
        inotify-tools
      rule_packages: amd-ucode
  08. configure_zram
      Configure zram as preferred swap.
      destination: /usr/lib/systemd/zram-generator.conf.d/60-mirroros.conf
      source_sha256:
        b6aa35ad3b4ee26a9296a50a45f215fd7e008fff05ad2fdbde67ba2a7f55f9cd
      zram_size: ram
      compression_algorithm: zstd
      swap_priority: 100
  09. configure_memory_reclaim
      Deliver the sysctl drop-in with the memory reclaim settings.
      destination: /usr/lib/sysctl.d/60-mirroros-memory.conf
      source_sha256:
        efa0ad6cc81d44518d21a8c9eca61635ca7dbacc55463d01ae74cded970ac678
      vm.swappiness: 180
      vm.page-cluster: 0
      vm.watermark_scale_factor: 125
      vm.watermark_boost_factor: 0
  10. generate_fstab
      Generate /etc/fstab by UUID.
      identifier: uuid
  11. create_swapfile
      Create the fallback swapfile, which also holds the hibernation image.
      path: /swapfile
      size_mib: 4096
      priority: 0
      resolved at apply: resume_offset (btrfs inspect-internal map-swapfile -r)
  12. configure_locale_time_console
      Configure locale, time, and console keymap.
      locales: en_US.UTF-8
      lang: en_US.UTF-8
      locale_categories: LANG=en_US.UTF-8; LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8;
        LC_NUMERIC=en_US.UTF-8; LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8;
        LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8
      console_keymap: us
      timezone: Europe/Madrid
      hardware_clock: utc
      time_sync: systemd-timesyncd
  13. configure_hostname_network
      Set the hostname and configure NetworkManager.
      hostname: mirroros-ref
      network_manager: NetworkManager
  14. create_user
      Create the user account and set its password from a protected prompt.
      user_name: mirroros
      groups: wheel
      shell: bash
  15. configure_root_account
      Configure the root account as selected.
      mode: password
  16. configure_sudo_sysrq_pacman
      Install the sudoers drop-in, the sysrq setting, and the pacman options.
      sudoers: %wheel ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL
      sysrq: kernel.sysrq = 1
      pacman_options: Color, ParallelDownloads = 5, VerbosePkgLists, ILoveCandy
  17. install_bootloader
      Install and configure the boot loader and the kernel command line.
      bootloader: limine
      kernel_cmdline: root=UUID=<root> rw zswap.enabled=0 resume=UUID=<root>
        resume_offset=<resume_offset>
      options: timeout=3; editor=false; fallback_entry=true
      resolved at apply: root_uuid (blkid)
      resolved at apply: resume_offset (btrfs inspect-internal map-swapfile -r)
  18. install_limine_snapshot_tools
      Build and install the pinned Limine snapshot tools.
  19. configure_snapper
      Create the Snapper root configuration for the root subvolume only.
  20. enable_services
      Enable the network, time sync, trim, and storage option services.
      services: NetworkManager, systemd-timesyncd, fstrim.timer
  21. create_baseline_snapshot
      Take the post-install baseline snapshot.
  22. sync_limine_snapshot_entries
      Write the Limine snapshot boot entries.

5. Secret requirements
======================
  Only names are recorded. Values are never stored in the plan.
  The root account receives the same password as the user; it is not an
  independent recovery credential.

  account_password
    Purpose           Password of the created user account, shared with the root
                      account when root password access is enabled.
    Required by       create_user, configure_root_account
    Channel           protected_prompt
    Provenance        technical_necessity

6. Hardware-derived selections
==============================
  Selections:
    target_disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
        fact storage.disks; rule single_eligible_disk; provenance
        hardware_detection
    boot_mode: uefi
        fact firmware.boot_mode; rule uefi_boot_mode_check; provenance
        hardware_detection

  Hardware rule outcomes:
    graphics: kernel_driver_only
        fact hardware.graphics; detected qemu_virtual
        Graphics vendors: qemu_virtual. The kernel driver and linux-firmware
        already installed are enough; nothing additional is selected.
    cpu-microcode: amd_microcode
        fact hardware.cpu.vendor; detected AuthenticAMD
        CPU vendor AuthenticAMD. The amd-ucode package is installed so the
        matching microcode is loaded at boot.
    battery: battery_absent
        fact hardware.battery_present; detected false
        No battery was detected. Nothing is selected.
    virtualization: virtual_machine
        fact hardware.virtualization; detected kvm
        Virtualization kvm was detected. Nothing is selected for it in this
        version.

  Packages selected by hardware rules:
    amd-ucode: rule cpu-microcode; provenance hardware_detection; not editable

7. Warnings
===========
  None.
